module purpose: neorv32_onewire holds bus-written control settings (enable, queue-clear request, clock prescaler select, clock divider), queues bus-written 1-Wire commands in a transmit FIFO, executes each queued command (single bit, byte, or reset with presence sample) by driving onewire_o and sampling onewire_i on a tick derived from clkgen_i and the divider, writes each result (data byte and presence bit) into a receive FIFO for bus readback, and raises irq_o when enabled with no pending command and an idle engine.

use-case flows.value: control settings (enable, queue-clear request, prescaler select, clock divider) taken from bus write data on a control-address write and held in ctrl
a 1-Wire command (2-bit operation code and data byte) written by the bus into the transmit queue, and the engine leaving idle when a queued command is pending
bit-time tick generated from the selected clkgen_i bit and the clock divider
command execution: command fetched from the transmit queue, bit/byte slots or reset/presence sequence timed in ticks, onewire_o driven and onewire_i sampled
result of a completed operation (received byte and presence bit) written into the receive queue and returned on a bus read of the data address; control settings returned on a control read
interrupt request when enabled with no pending command and an idle engine; status bits (transmit queue full, receive data available, sensed line level, busy); clock-generator enable output

rstn_i clears control, tick and engine registers; a cleared enable or a clear request flushes both queues, a cleared enable also holds the tick counter at zero and sends the engine to its clearing arm

conceptual assets.concept: Controller enable -- the held on/off state of the 1-Wire controller
conceptual assets.reasoning: The configure flow stores bit 0 of a control write: `ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c);` (line 142, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3, reset to '0' at line 130). The module's behavior depends on this state: it forces both queue clears (lines 199, 231), holds the tick counter at zero (lines 258-259), drives engine state bit 2 (line 311, COPIES), so a cleared enable sends the engine to the others arm that clears sreg, presence and the phase (lines 383-387), qualifies irq_o (line 243), and is exported by `clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable;` (line 273). Integrity is Established: a wrong value starts or stops the engine, flushes queued commands, or misstates the clock-generator request relative to the stored setting. Availability is also Established: a cleared enable stops every operation (lines 199, 259, 311). ctrl.enable stores it; clkgen_en_o is the exit port (COPIES ctrl.enable, occurrence 2) delivering it outside the entity. The readback on bus_rsp_o.data (line 150) is not listed because bus_rsp_o is a transport record.

conceptual assets.concept: Bit-timing configuration -- the prescaler select and clock divider that set the tick period
conceptual assets.reasoning: `ctrl.clk_prsc <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_prsc1_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c);` (line 144) and `ctrl.clk_div <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_clkdiv7_c downto ctrl_clkdiv0_c);` (line 145) hold the timing settings (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3 each; reset at lines 131-132). clk_prsc selects which clk_src bit lets the counter advance (`elsif (clk_src(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.clk_prsc))) = '1') then`, line 260; SELECTS clk_cnt and clk_tick) and clk_div sets the count at which the tick fires (`if (clk_cnt = unsigned(ctrl.clk_div)) then`, line 261; CONSTRAINS clk_cnt and clk_tick). Every slot length and sample point is counted in ticks (lines 342-380), so Integrity is Established: a wrong setting changes the onewire_o waveform timing and the sampling instants. Both registers store the setting. clkgen_i is not listed: through clk_src (line 276) it only enables the tick counter's advance at line 260, so the clock-enable rule excludes it, and clk_src only forwards its slice and gates. The readback (lines 151-152) leaves only through the transport record bus_rsp_o.

conceptual assets.concept: Bit-time tick -- the counted time base that paces every 1-Wire slot
conceptual assets.reasoning: The clock_generator process counts with `clk_cnt <= clk_cnt + 1;` (line 265) and, when clk_cnt equals clk_div, clears it and sets `clk_tick <= '1';` (lines 261-263); clk_tick is cleared otherwise (line 257) and delayed into clk_tick2 (line 268). The engine depends on this event: fifo.tx_re fires on clk_tick (line 202), a slot starts only on clk_tick (lines 329-330), tick_cnt advances only on clk_tick (lines 360-361, 366-367), and the read and presence samples are taken on clk_tick2 (lines 346, 374). Integrity is Established: a corrupted counter or tick changes every slot length and sample point of the waveform and the command-consumption instant. clk_cnt stores the counting state (self-updating, CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 6), clk_tick stores the tick event (CLOCKED_BY at occurrence 5, line 263; it is also the comparison result, CONSTRAINED_BY ctrl.clk_div), and clk_tick2 stores its one-cycle-delayed copy that times sampling (CLOCKED_BY at occurrence 3, line 268), a storing element even though it captures unchanged data.

conceptual assets.reasoning: A control write sets `ctrl.clear <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_clear_c);` (line 143), and `ctrl.clear <= '0';` (line 140) makes it a one-cycle request (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 4). fifo.tx_clr and fifo.rx_clr compute the flush decision `'1' when (ctrl.enable = '0') or (ctrl.clear = '1') else '0'` (lines 199, 231; GATED_BY ctrl.clear and ctrl.enable at occurrence 3) and deliver it to the clear_i ports of tx_fifo_inst and rx_fifo_inst (lines 186, 218), whose internals are not supplied. Integrity is Established by that delivery: each queue must receive exactly this decision, so queued commands and unread results are discarded when, and only when, the module is disabled or a clear is requested. Availability is also Established: a spurious flush drops pending commands and results. Both fields are computed here from a decision, so the sub-unit wiring exception is satisfied; ctrl.enable is listed under its own concept.

conceptual assets.reasoning: The start flow leaves idle only on `if (fifo.tx_avail = '1') then`, which sets the phase bits to 01 (lines 317-318); the same value blocks irq_o (line 243) and is reported as busy (line 159). conceptual assets.concept: Queued command word -- the operation code (single bit, byte, reset) and transmit data byte of the command being executed
conceptual assets.reasoning: tx_fifo_inst delivers the next command on fifo.tx_rdata (CONNECTS tx_fifo_inst.rdata_o, occurrence 2, line 195). Integrity is Established: the executed operation and the bits driven on onewire_o must be those of the queued command. fifo.tx_rdata is tested in an if and a case condition, so the sub-unit wiring exception applies, and it sets the value here through the connection from the sub-unit output.

conceptual assets.reasoning: serial.state holds the phase: bit 2 follows ctrl.enable (line 311) and bits 1-0 move from idle to fetch on a pending command (line 318), from fetch to the slot or reset phase by the command code (lines 331-335), and back to idle at the end of a bit or byte (line 356), at presence end (line 380), or in the others arm (line 387); it selects every engine assignment (SELECTS at line 312) and the consumption strobe (line 202). serial.busy computes `'0' when (serial.state(1 downto 0) = 00) else '1'` (line 394; GATED_BY serial.state, occurrence 5), which releases onewire_o when idle (line 299), blocks irq_o (line 243) and is reported as status (line 159).
